Informamos que o cronograma pode ser adiantado ao longo do dia, por isso esteja no local para competir pelo menos 30 minutos antes da sua modalidade começar. 🇺🇸 Welcome to Colégio Salesiano BC Open 2025! The first official competition in the city of Balneário Camboriú! Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment is confirmed, which must be made in advance – more information is available in the "Register" tab. If you have difficulties registering, please watch this video: https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. ATTENTION! Please note that the schedule may be brought forward throughout the day, so make sure to be at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts.
